notes: Foscam's official FAQ documents exactly two RTSP video paths: /videoMain (main stream) and /videoSub (sub stream). A third path /audio provides audio-only with no video. The default RTSP port is 88 (matches the HTTP port default). A subset of models — including C1, C1 Lite, FI9816P, FI9800P, FI9803P V2, C1 Lite V3, C1 V3, FI9800P V3, FI9803P V4, FI9816P V3, FI9821EP V2, FI9821P V3, FI9826P V3, FI9831P V3, FI9851P V3, and FI9853EP V2 — use RTSP port 554 instead of 88. No codec is specified in the official FAQ (codec depends on the camera model's configured profile). Full URL form: rtsp://{user}:{pass}@{ip}:{port}/videoMain. Foscam is an independent brand (not a known Dahua/Hikvision OEM at firmware level); the .sdp-style paths in leads are cross-brand contamination.
